info.title: Alteris Multiple Tenant SAAS
info.description: Skolarly / Alteris API. Endpoints marked with a lock need a Supabase access token: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Get one from POST /auth/login.

post.description:
Every attempt counts against the caller's IP and the account. Only a successful
sign-in (which needs the password) clears the account's count, so guessing stops
after a few tries however many IPs the guesses come from. Unknown emails are
counted the same way, so the limit says nothing about which accounts exist.

Create an account and email a confirmation link (via Resend). The same answer
whether or not the email already has an account.

Set the signed-in user's password (after a reset link, or when joining from an
invite), checked against the password rules first. The frontend calls this instead
of Supabase's updateUser, which can't apply them.

Called after the client has already created (or signed into) their Supabase
account — get_current_user has a local `users` row for them by this point.
This just creates their tenant and makes them its owner.

Expected payload:
{
  name, slug, workspace_id, country, phone (required), type, source
}

Send the profile's `notes` plus `qualifications` if it changed.

get.description:
Without `?page=`: every mark for the class/term/year, as before. With it: one page
of the class roster ranked by average (search: student name), plus class-wide
subjects, averages, trends and summary.

schema.title: Response Get Class Performance Performance Get

patch.description:
Replaces the marks of the students in the payload for the given class/term/year;
students not in it keep theirs. For a student in the payload, a blank/omitted
score for a subject removes any previously-saved score for it. Rows name the
student by `student_id`; a row with only `student` (a name) is for older marks
that were never matched to a student.
